title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 2: Israel passes Edom, Moab and Ammon, and defeats Sihon king of Heshbon.

questions.text: After Israel had encircled Mount Seir long enough, which way did Yahweh tell them to turn?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward."

questions.text: Why were the Israelites not to contend with the children of Esau?
questions.explanation: Yahweh would not give them any of their land, because he had given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.

answers.text: The children of Esau were too strong
Esau had paid tribute to Moses
Yahweh had given Mount Seir to Esau

questions.text: How were the Israelites to get food and water from the children of Esau?
questions.explanation: They were to purchase food from them for money and also buy water from them for money.

questions.text: What does Moses say about Israel's forty years in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: These forty years Yahweh their God had been with them, and they had lacked nothing.

answers.text: They had lost all their livestock

questions.text: To whom had Yahweh given Ar for a possession?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses not to bother Moab, because he had given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.

questions.text: What did the Moabites call the tall people who lived there before?
questions.explanation: A great, numerous and tall people lived there before; they are considered Rephaim, but the Moabites call them Emim.

questions.text: How long was it from leaving Kadesh Barnea until Israel crossed the brook Zered?
questions.explanation: The days from Kadesh Barnea until they came over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years.

questions.text: Which king did Yahweh say he had given into Israel's hand when they crossed the Arnon?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he had given into their hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land.

answers.text: Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon

questions.text: Why would Sihon not let Israel pass through his land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into Israel's hand.

answers.text: Israel refused to pay for water
Moab had warned him against Israel

questions.text: Where did Sihon and all his people come out to fight Israel?
questions.explanation: Sihon came out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
